plugins.name: creview
plugins.description: Multi-agent parallel code review workflow: start → triage → respond → resolve, with an automatic multi-round driver. Reviewers and fixers are resolved from the destination project's .claude/agents. Triage is adversarial (propose → three parallel challenges → majority-gated adjudication) and the multi-round driver runs each phase in a sub-agent, so both require a runtime with nested sub-agent spawning. Reviewing a GitHub pull request by URL requires an authenticated GitHub CLI (gh).

plugins.name: cprompt
plugins.description: Create and edit AI-facing prompts (agent / skill / rule / command) and self-check / fix them against prompt-discipline rules.

plugins.name: cdev
plugins.description: Team-native multi-agent coding workflow: a standing team runs design and coding as paired review cells, then a QA gate. Architects, coders, and reviewers are resolved from the destination project's .claude/agents. Requires a runtime with background subagents and inter-agent messaging.

plugins.name: cgh
plugins.description: GitHub pull request workflow on top of creview: post a triaged review, run a merge gate until it passes, answer posted reviews with fixes, and verify the fixes of your own review. Nothing is posted without the user's instruction, and the plugin never approves or merges. Requires the creview plugin and an authenticated GitHub CLI (gh).
